name: comet-dial

frames.best_why: The left dial reads 84% after a drag, its green arc long and its handle at the end; the right dial rests.

tagline: A radial dial you drag or flick, with a comet streak behind the value.
summary: A circular control open at the bottom, showing a large number inside and a coloured arc from the start to the current value. Dragging or flicking the arc changes the value with a springy overshoot, and a comet tail trails the moving handle.
appearance: Two open-ring dials side by side on black, each with a faint full arc and a bright coloured arc ending in a small round handle. A large light number sits in the middle with a smaller unit, and the rings are open at the bottom.
behaviour: Dragging around the arc follows the pointer, and releasing with speed flicks the value on and springs it back with a small overshoot at the ends. A widening comet tail streaks behind the handle while it moves, and keys step the value.
demo_content: Two dials, Volume at 62 percent and Temperature at 21 degrees, with Volume changing during the clip.
search_phrases: drag around a ring to set a value
use_when: A dashboard or media control wants a compact, tactile dial instead of a straight slider.
avoid_when: It is a fixed square size with a large dead centre, and small drags make precise values fiddly.
customise: Props set the value, range, step, unit, label, accent and ink colours, size, sweep, thickness, speed, bounce, momentum and comet reach and width.
weight_why: One SVG arc and a dozen comet segments, animated only while the value moves.

a11y.note: Full keyboard control and a proper slider role, but the dial draws no focus ring when tabbed to.

issues: There is no visible focus indicator on the dial.
polish_why: Distinctive comet motion and a clean big readout; the thin track is low contrast at rest.
title: Comet Dial
